description: This Java interface defines the MerchantConfigurationService, which provides methods for managing merchant configurations within the system, including retrieving, saving, and listing configurations for specific merchant stores.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationService
classes.description: A Java interface for managing merchant configuration data, extending common entity service functionalities and adding specific methods for retrieving and saving merchant configuration details.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific merchant configuration based on a key and store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new merchant configuration or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all merchant configurations associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists merchant configurations filtered by configuration type and store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfig
methods.description: Returns the merchant's configuration settings as a MerchantConfig object for a given store.

methods.name: saveMerchantConfig
methods.description: Saves merchant configuration settings for a specific store.
